mapper.select:
SELECT p.product_no, thumb.thumbnail_url, p.name, c.name AS category_name, p.price, p.discount_rate, TRUNC((p.price - (p.price * p.discount_rate / 100)) / 100) * 100 AS sale_price, p.use_yn, p.view_count, p.same_day_delivery_yn, p.created_at FROM product p JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.product_no, x.image_url AS thumbnail_url FROM ( SELECT pi.product_no, pi.image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.product_no ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.product_img_no ASC ) AS rn FROM product_img pi WHERE pi.image_type = 'THUMB' ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ) thumb ON p.product_no = thumb.product_no
AND p.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND p.category_id IN ( SELECT category_id FROM category START WITH category_id = #{searchCategoryId} CONNECT BY PRIOR category_id = parent_id )
AND p.use_yn = #{useYn}
AND p.same_day_delivery_yn = #{sameDayDeliveryYn}
ORDER BY p.product_no DESC OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * #{size} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.product_no, p.name, p.price, p.discount_rate, TRUNC((p.price - (p.price * p.discount_rate / 100)) / 100) * 100 AS sale_price, p.category_id, p.description, p.use_yn, p.same_day_delivery_yn, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM product p WHERE p.product_no = #{productNo}
SELECT product_img_no, product_no, image_url, image_type, sort_order FROM product_img WHERE product_no = #{productNo} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, product_img_no ASC
SELECT product_option_no, product_no, option_size, color, stock, use_yn FROM product_option WHERE product_no = #{productNo} ORDER BY product_option_no ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_product.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO product ( product_no, name, price, discount_rate, category_id, description, use_yn, created_at, updated_at, view_count, same_day_delivery_yn ) VALUES ( #{productNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{discountRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{categoryId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, 0, #{sameDayDeliveryYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
INSERT INTO product_img ( product_img_no, product_no, image_url, image_type, sort_order ) VALUES ( seq_product_img.NEXTVAL, #{productNo}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageType}, #{sortOrder} )

INSERT INTO product_option ( product_option_no, product_no, option_size, color, stock, use_yn ) VALUES ( seq_product_option.NEXTVAL, #{productNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{optionSize, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{color, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stock, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{dto.productName}, price = #{dto.price}, discount_rate = #{dto.discountRate}, use_yn = #{dto.useYn}, same_day_delivery_yn = #{dto.sameDayDeliveryYn}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE product_no = #{productNo}
mapper.select: SELECT product_option_no, product_no, option_size, color, stock, use_yn FROM product_option WHERE product_no = #{productNo} AND product_option_no = #{productOptionNo}
